cause_quote: The new candidate admission call added `handoffFromGateway: (state) =>` to service inspection, activating the ancestry guard on a path that passed no `updateRun`.
user_saw: A Gateway-triggered update under systemd rejected its authorized helper as being inside the Gateway process tree and stopped before replacing the package.
summary: Candidate inspection falls back to the inherited update run ID to verify the helper's live handoff lease.
reasoning: The parent of #155632 passed `updateRun: opts.run` to managed package inspection, and #153020 recorded a successful Linux handoff. The new candidate inspection supplied a handoff callback without supplying `updateRun`, so the guard rejected the helper before checking its lease. The later guard rewrite in #158314 preserved the same run-ID lookup.
